user.title: Add an alarm
user.description: Every alarm has its own player, its own wake-up sound and its own schedule. Add one per person or per room.

data_description.name: Shown on the device and in front of every entity, for example "Bedroom".
data_description.player: The player the wake-up sound comes out of.
data_description.lights: Optional. These lights fade in before the alarm goes off.

data_description.notify_service: Optional, for example notify.mobile_app_phone. Gets a message when the alarm could not go off.
data_description.squeezebox_host: Optional. IP address of a Squeezebox running the HAWekker applet, which then shows the bell and the wake-up window itself.
data_description.squeezebox_port: The udp port the applet listens on. Leave at 9997 unless you changed it.

trigger.name: Start the wake-up
trigger.description: Runs the wake-up right now, as if the alarm had gone off.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stops a running wake-up and arms the alarm again.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Silences the alarm and brings it back after the snooze time.

refresh_media.name: Refresh the library
refresh_media.description: Reads the radio stations and playlists from Music Assistant again.
